module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 50) that spawns, tracks and deletes prefabs (groups of scene objects, .prefab.json) during a project. When a prefab is added, it lists all child objects by class, stores the vehicles' transforms, detects whether colliders or waypoints / roads (navgraph) are contained, then reloads the collision (be:reloadCollision) and the navgraph (map.reset) at the right time. On stop, it deletes all prefabs not marked dontDelete.
notes: spawnPrefab resolves <name>/<name>.prefab.json relative to the project, places the prefab at (0,0,0), canSave = false, in MissionGroup.
During level loading, reloads go through mgr.modules.level:delayOrInstantFunction; otherwise they are done in afterTrigger via flags.
If a BeamNGGameplayArea is part of the prefab, collision and navgraph are reloaded immediately ('hacky' workaround commented in the code).
Non-vehicle objects with a Name generate a warning: use Internal Name. Vehicles named 'clone...' too.

init.desc: Creates the tables prefabs, sortedIds, flags then calls clear().

afterTrigger.desc: Called after the graph tick: reloads the collision and rebuilds the navgraph (map.reset, except during loading) if the flags are raised.

originalVehicleTransforms.desc: Computes {pos, rot, up} for each vehicle (BeamNGVehicle) of the prefab and adds them to the manager's vehicle module.

getPrefab.desc: Returns the data of the tracked prefab, or an empty table.

spawnPrefab.desc: Creates a prefab from <name>.prefab.json (path relative to the project), adds it to MissionGroup and tracks it via addPrefab.

addPrefab.desc: Tracks an existing prefab in the scene: lists its children, its vehicles, detects colliders and navgraph and schedules the necessary reloads.

moreData.desc: fields copied into the data; skipCollisionReload, skipNavgraphReload

restoreVehiclePositions.desc: Puts the prefab's vehicles back at their original position and rotation and resets the physics and the deformations.

getVehicleIdsForPrefab.desc: Returns the ids of the vehicles contained in the prefab, sorted.

unpackPrefabAndDelete.desc: Explodes the prefab (obj:explode), deletes the prefab then reinserts its vehicles into MissionGroup at their current position before deleting the remaining group.

setUnpackVehiclesBeforeDeletion.desc: Indicates whether the vehicles must be extracted before the prefab is deleted.

setKeepPrefab.desc: Marks the prefab as to be kept when the project stops (dontDelete). Warns if the prefab is not tracked.

deletePrefab.desc: Deletes the prefab (except dontDelete without force), removes it from tracking and schedules a collision reload if it contained any.

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: deletes all tracked prefabs not marked dontDelete, reloads collision and navgraph if needed, then calls clear().
